_comment: The bound graded operating point. Every field here is FROZEN. A recipe that names any of these keys is a frozen-axis write and is recorded as one.
_data_seed_dist_note: the transition table of the frozen source. This IS the dataset and it is a frozen axis.
data_draw_val: verifier-only, never present on the agent surface
operating_point_state: MEASURED on the bound envelope. One H100 80GB, the verifier's own image, the substrate below: 0.215 s per optimizer step and 4.4 s to build the substrate, so a 100-step attempt costs 21.5 s and the whole graded session -- six handed probes, three refined probes and sixteen attempts -- lands near 540 s. The previous point carried 12 layers, model_dim 768, batch_tokens_per_step 524288, max_steps 3600 and stream_tokens_train 268435456; that measured 15.6 s per step (24.1 s under a contended card), which is a 20.8 minute single attempt against a 20-attempt session, and it was never timed before it was bound.
_operating_point_note: Re-scaled, not softened. Every axis below is still frozen and the graded quantity is unchanged: the first scheduled evaluation at or below target_loss that holds for sustain_window further points. target_loss stays 3.28 because it is still crossable here and still discriminating -- measured at this point, an orthogonalized-momentum recipe crosses at step 70 and a plain momentum, a plain adamw and a low-learning-rate ortho do not cross at all inside max_steps.
